title: SourdoughCalc 2026 Open Cereal Rheology, True Total Hydration & Thermodynamic Ice Benchmark Dataset (1,200 Parameter Combinations)
description: Empirical and physics-modeled dataset of 1,200 sourdough baking parameter combinations across 6 flour classes, 10 hydration levels (62%-90%), 5 starter inoculation ratios (10%-30%), and 4 ambient temperatures (68F-82F). Powered by SourdoughCalc (https://sourdoughcalc.app).
